items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: there’s this couple, Bob Christensen and his wife, that live in California. And they have Bix Beiderbecke’s cornet.

ctx.x: Did I read that you used some of his own instruments on that?

Oh yeah. That was kind of an interesting thing. And well George was kind of responsible for getting, there’s this couple, Bob Christensen and his wife, that live in California. And they have Bix Beiderbecke’s cornet. It was engraved with his name on it and everything like that. A Bach, this silver Bach cornet. And they just agreed to come to the concert at their own expense and lend us the cornet, and I had never met these people. And it was unbelievable.
